purpose: Confirm whether the frozen M5b primary conclusions replicate on the previously untouched 100-example sentinel split.
confirmatory_question: Do the primary M5b conclusions replicate on the untouched sentinel set under the already-selected model, retrieval method, inference contract, answer extraction, and scoring procedure?

selected_lora.selection_rule: Reuse the already-frozen M5b validation-selected candidate. No sentinel-based candidate selection is permitted.

inference.answer_extraction: Take the first non-empty generated line, strip surrounding whitespace, then remove at most one trailing period.
inference.scoring: Use the existing AdaptLab score_output implementation.

retrieval.policy: Use the same frozen retrieval implementation and retrieval settings as corrected M5b validation/primary evaluation. No retriever tuning or k-selection may use sentinel outcomes.
retrieval.important_note: The sentinel retrieval artifact must be generated or loaded using only the already-frozen BM25 configuration. Its identity/hash must be recorded before model outputs are scored.

evaluation.run_policy: Evaluate each of the four frozen conditions once. Do not inspect partial condition-level accuracy and then modify configuration.
primary_metrics: overall exact-match accuracy for each condition
family-level exact-match accuracy for each condition
paired accuracy differences on identical sentinel examples
evaluation.paired_test: Exact two-sided McNemar/binomial test on discordant pairs, reported descriptively with no multiple-testing adjustment.

frozen_hypotheses.H1: Retrieval will outperform PROMPT overall, driven primarily by knowledge-bearing task families.
frozen_hypotheses.H2: LoRA will outperform PROMPT overall, driven primarily by behavior-only performance.
frozen_hypotheses.H3: LoRA+RAG will outperform RAG overall, indicating useful marginal contribution from weight adaptation given retrieval.
frozen_hypotheses.H4: LoRA+RAG will outperform LoRA overall, indicating useful marginal contribution from retrieval given weight adaptation.
frozen_hypotheses.H5: LoRA+RAG will achieve the highest overall accuracy of the four conditions.

family_expectations.behavior_only: LoRA-containing conditions should outperform non-LoRA conditions.
family_expectations.knowledge_only: Retrieval-containing conditions should outperform corresponding non-retrieval conditions.
family_expectations.changed_knowledge: Retrieval-containing conditions should outperform corresponding non-retrieval conditions.
family_expectations.behavior_knowledge: No directional claim that LoRA+RAG must exceed RAG, because primary M5b showed mild interference on this family.

prohibited_after_sentinel_access: changing LoRA rank, policy, learning rate, or checkpoint
changing retrieval method or retrieval hyperparameters
adding sentinel-derived heuristics or normalization rules
rerunning after observing results for the purpose of improving scores
allowed_after_sentinel_access: Correct a demonstrable implementation failure only if the failure prevents execution of the already-frozen protocol; preserve the failed run and document the correction explicitly.
Compute predeclared aggregate and paired statistics from frozen outputs.
Write results, limitations, and interpretation without altering outputs.
interpretation_rule: Treat the sentinel as confirmatory evidence about replication of the already-observed M5b pattern, not as a new model-selection or tuning set.
